builds.goal: Reference for Nasus: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A stacking melee fighter who farms empowered Q kills, slows a priority target and uses his ultimate to sustain repeated Q contact. Fix earned Q stacks and R state. E-zone AP/burn is a separate experiment, not bonus Q damage; compare mana, wave control and reaching the target under Wither. Armor and a real Spellblade attack may preserve close fighting windows.
testPlan: Kit question for Nasus: Fix earned Q stacks and R state. E-zone AP/burn is a separate experiment, not bonus Q damage; compare mana, wave control and reaching the target under Wither.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.
